articles.title: Pakistan rolls out first Chinese Hangor submarine (VIDEO)
articles.summary: Pakistan has launched the first of eight Chinese-built Hangor-class submarines, significantly expanding its undersea fleet. This move deepens defence cooperation between Islamabad and Beijing, underscoring their strategic partnership. For SSB aspirants, this highlights Pakistan's ongoing military modernization efforts and the evolving geopolitical dynamics in the region, particularly concerning naval power and international defence alliances.

articles.title: Russia hammers targets across Ukraine overnight
articles.summary: Russia has continued heavy attacks on Ukraine for the past 24 hours, with strikes occurring overnight on Thursday and into early Friday morning. These sustained assaults have resulted in at least one fatality and several injuries. The ongoing aggression underscores the persistent nature of the conflict and the immediate humanitarian impact of the hostilities in Eastern Europe, a key point for global security analysis.

articles.title: If I Could Make My Own GitHub
articles.summary: Two friends engage in a game contemplating extreme wealth, differentiating it from conventional financial security. They illustrate immense riches with the imaginative example of owning a personal submarine that its proprietor has never entered. This thought experiment explores the hypothetical dimensions of extraordinary fortune and the unconventional possessions or experiences associated with such a lifestyle.

articles.title: Fertiliser output steady despite West Asia crisis; govt secures 37 lac ton urea imports for kharif
articles.summary: The government reported robust domestic urea production of 37.49 lakh tonnes in March-April, almost matching last year's levels despite the West Asia crisis. Concurrently, 37 lakh tonnes of urea were secured through imports. This ensures sufficient availability for the upcoming Kharif season, stabilizing agricultural output, and supporting farmers nationwide amidst global uncertainties.

articles.title: Skoda Volkswagen Group builds global car and software hub in India with Pune R&D expansion
articles.summary: Skoda Volkswagen Group is significantly expanding its R&D facility in Pune, India, by 33,000 sq ft. This move aims to establish India as a global engineering hub, aligning with the "Make in India, for India and the world" strategy. It marks a major step towards bolstering domestic manufacturing and design capabilities, leveraging India's talent for global automotive markets.

articles.title: HAL Chairman & Managing Director D K Sunil steps down
articles.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd. (HAL) announced that its Chairman and Managing Director, Dr. D K Sunil, has stepped down from his position. This significant leadership change at India's state-owned aerospace and defence company is crucial. HAL plays a pivotal role in manufacturing critical aircraft and equipment for the Indian armed forces, making this development noteworthy for the national defence sector and its future trajectory.

articles.title: Wreckage of Coast Guard ship lost during WWI found off coast of England
articles.summary: The wreckage of a U.S. Coast Guard ship, lost over a century ago during a deadly World War I attack, has been discovered off the coast of England. The discovery, announced by the Coast Guard, sheds light on historical maritime losses and naval operations during the Great War, offering valuable insights into past defence challenges and recoveries of significant military assets.

articles.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Opens at #1 in Japan, Sound! Euphonium, The Final Movie Part 1 Anime Opens at #4
articles.summary: Nintendo, Illumination, and Universal Pictures are reportedly developing "The Super Mario Galaxy Movie," a highly anticipated sequel to "The Super Mario Bros. Movie." This major international collaboration aims to further expand the beloved gaming franchise into the cinematic universe, promising new adventures and characters to captivate global audiences. The project highlights significant developments in worldwide entertainment media.
